बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम चटपटी खबर! 🎬

बुधवार को मुंबई में फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya का धमाकेदार trailer लॉन्च हुआ। 🎥

डायरेक्टर सूरज बड़जात्या का कहना है कि जब उनके पास यह सब्जेक्ट आया, तो उनके दिमाग में सिर्फ आयुष्मान खुराना का ही नाम आया था। 💭

उनका कहना है कि आयुष्मान अपनी फिल्मों और पर्सनल लाइफ में हर बात पर एक सही सवाल रखते हैं और उनमें सादगी है। ✨

वहीं आयुष्मान खुराना का कहना है कि सलमान खान ही ओरिजिनल प्रेम हैं और सलमान जैसी पहचान वाले किरदार को निभाना बहुत बड़ी जिम्मेदारी है। 🤝

डायरेक्टर ने यह भी बताया कि जैसे वे सलमान खान को अपना अंदाज लाने देते थे, वैसे ही उन्होंने आयुष्मान को भी अपनी पर्सनैलिटी के हिसाब से किरदार निभाने की पूरी छूट दी है। 🌟

यह फैमिली ड्रामा फिल्म 27 नवंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी और इसका रनटाइम करीब 2 घंटे 53 मिनट है। 🍿

क्या आपको लगता है कि आयुष्मान खुराना पर 'प्रेम' का यह नया अंदाज दर्शकों को पसंद आएगा? नीचे कमेंट करके जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Sooraj Barjatya reveals why Ayushmann Khurrana was his only choice in Yeh Prem Mol Liya; actor calls Salman Khan ‘OG Prem’
ctx.summary: At the trailer launch in Mumbai, the director Sooraj Barjatya spoke about what made Ayushmann Khurrana the right choice for Prem in Yeh Prem Mol Liya.
ctx.text:
Sooraj Barjatya is bringing back his iconic character Prem, with Ayushmann Khurrana taking over the role this time. The trailer of Yeh Prem Mol Liya was released on Wednesday, offering a first look at the family drama co-starring Sharvari. At the trailer launch in Mumbai, the director spoke about what made Ayushmann the right choice for Prem and how he allowed the actor to bring his own touch to the character, just as Salman Khan had done in his films. Ayushmann, on the other hand, acknowledged that playing a role so closely identified with Salman comes with its own set of expectations and a huge responsibility.
Ayushmann is aware that audiences have a strong association between Salman Khan and the character of Prem, which the actor played in several Rajshri films. Shahid Kapoor also portrayed Prem in Vivaah. When asked if Ayushmann has any favourite films of Salman where he played the role, the actor said,  “There's no one better than Salman Khan as Prem. He is the OG Prem. His launch in the industry was also with Prem. I think becoming Prem is a huge responsibility. You have to walk the talk. You really have to understand what makes a perfect man, someone who is sensitive and kind. I think that's the Prem in this film.”
Ayushmann was the first name that came to mind when Sooraj Barjatya was introduced to the story. The filmmaker explained that he wanted an actor who could bring a certain simplicity to a Prem who questions things in his own gentle way.
“Actually, honestly, when this subject came to me, it was about a Prem who, from his own perspective and in his own tender voice, questions certain things. So, when this subject first came up, only Ayushmann was on my mind,” Barjatya said. “Because if you look at his filmography, and even personally, Ayushmann has a very valid question on every point of view, and he carries a certain simplicity that is evident in the films he does—whether it’s Bala or Dream Girl," he said at the launch.
The director also spoke about the connection between Ayushmann and Salman Khan, who made Prem one of the most recognisable characters in Rajshri films. Barjatya said he follows a similar approach with both actors, allowing them to bring their own personality to the role rather than asking them to imitate someone else's interpretation.
“And the similarity between both of them [Ayushmann and Salman Khan] is that I let them be the way they are. I let them do their own thing. On the very first day, I saw that he caught the sur (essence/tone) of Prem so well that I said I didn’t want to touch it. It’s the same with Salman bhai. I go to meet him, I narrate the scene, and then he gives it his own spin. That is his Prem, and this is his [Ayushmann’s] Prem," he said.
The cast also includes Anupam Kher, Supriya Pathak Kapur, Seema Pahwa, Swanand Kirkire, Saumya Tandon, Shruti Seth, Shaad Randhawa, Girish Kulkarni and Rajesh Kumar, among others.
Produced by Rajshri Productions (P) Ltd. in association with Mahaveer Jain Films, the film marks Barjatya's return to direction after Uunchai, which won a National Award. He has reunited with composer Himesh Reshammiya for the soundtrack after Prem Ratan Dhan Payo. One of the tracks featured in the film's promotions is Jhumka Patola, sung by Shreya Ghoshal.
The Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has reportedly granted the film a U/A 13+ certificate. Its runtime is approximately 2 hours and 53 minutes. Yeh Prem Mol Liya will release in theatres worldwide on November 27, 2026. It will face a box-office clash with Gunmaaster G9, starring Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh.
